 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.name AS league_name,aliases.keys AS league_keys,
 totals.matches_count AS match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL) LIMIT 1) published ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys FROM ingest.public_aliases a

WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.system_id,s.edition_key)
  s.id AS snapshot_id,s.system_id,s.subject_kind,s.edition_key,s.official_edition,
  CASE WHEN octet_length(s.period_label)<=1024 THEN s.period_label END AS period_label,
  coalesce(octet_length(s.period_label)>1024,false) AS long_period,
  s.recorded_from_gen AS observed_gen,s.revision,s.base_season_year,s.target_season_year,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.effective_on) THEN to_char(s.effective_on,'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS effective_on,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.retrieved_at) THEN
 to_char(s.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS retrieved_at,CASE WHEN isfinite(s.source_updated_at) THEN
 to_char(s.source_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS source_updated_at,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.published_at) THEN
 to_char(s.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS published_at,
  sys.code AS kind,src.code AS source_code,d.id AS document_id,d.source_id,d.content_sha256,
  CASE WHEN octet_length(d.source_url)<=2048 THEN d.source_url END AS source_url,
  coalesce(s.quality_flags->'ranking_collection_complete'='true'::jsonb,false) AS complete
 FROM football.ranking_snapshots s
 JOIN football.ranking_systems sys ON sys.id=s.system_id AND sys.subject_kind=s.subject_kind
  AND sys.recorded_from_gen<=s.recorded_from_gen AND sys.gender='men'
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots origin ON origin.generation=s.recorded_from_gen AND origin.status='sealed'
 JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=s.source_document_id
 JOIN ingest.sources src ON src.id=d.source_id
 JOIN ingest.source_datasets ds ON ds.id=d.dataset_id AND ds.source_id=d.source_id
  AND ds.contract_version='orion-rankings-v1' AND ds.dataset_key='rankings:' || sys.code
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=d.id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
 WHERE s.recorded_from_gen<=$1::bigint
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR sys.code=$3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR s.edition_key=$4)
  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR src.code=$5)
  AND ((sys.code='uefa-associations' AND sys.subject_kind='association')
    OR (sys.code IN ('fifa-men','uefa-clubs') AND sys.subject_kind='team'))
  AND ((src.code='uefa' AND sys.authority='UEFA' AND sys.code<>'fifa-men' AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}[.]uefa$')
    OR (src.code='fifa' AND sys.authority='FIFA' AND sys.code='fifa-men'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]fifa$')
    OR (src.code='sportsapi' AND sys.authority='SportsAPI'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]sportsapi$'))
 ORDER BY s.system_id,s.edition_key,s.revision DESC
), scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM latest ORDER BY kind COLLATE "C" DESC,edition_key COLLATE "C" DESC,system_id
 LIMIT 513
), entries AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.team_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 r.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.document_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN s.source_code='uefa' THEN r.external_key ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    ELSE char_length(btrim(r.external_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.external_key !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' END
  AND char_length(btrim(p.display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND p.display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  AND coalesce(char_length(p.country_code_source)<=64 AND p.country_code_source !~ '[[:cntrl:]]',true)
  AND coalesce(e.points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(e.earned_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid,
  512 + 2 * (coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.display_name)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.country_code_source)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT e.* FROM football.team_ranking_entries e WHERE e.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id 
 ORDER BY e.team_id LIMIT 4097
) e
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.team_source_ids m ON m.team_id=e.team_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records mr ON mr.id=m.source_record_id AND mr.source_id=m.source_id AND mr.external_key=m.external_id
LEFT JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.team_id=e.team_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key
 AND p.variant_key='source:exact' AND p.is_canonical AND p.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT p.is_deleted

WHERE s.subject_kind='team' AND s.complete
UNION ALL
SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.association_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 r.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.document_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN s.source_code='uefa' THEN r.external_key ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    ELSE char_length(btrim(r.external_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.external_key !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' END
  AND char_length(btrim(p.display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND p.display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  AND coalesce(char_length(p.country_code_source)<=64 AND p.country_code_source !~ '[[:cntrl:]]',true)
  AND coalesce(e.coefficient::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(e.earned_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid,
  512 + 2 * (coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.display_name)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.country_code_source)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT e.* FROM football.association_ranking_entries e WHERE e.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id 
 ORDER BY e.association_id LIMIT 4097
) e
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.association_source_ids m ON m.association_id=e.association_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records mr ON mr.id=m.source_record_id AND mr.source_id=m.source_id AND mr.external_key=m.external_id
LEFT JOIN football.association_profile_versions p ON p.association_id=e.association_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key
 AND p.variant_key='source:exact' AND p.is_canonical AND p.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT p.is_deleted

WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete
), facts AS (
 SELECT snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS row_count,
  count(DISTINCT actor_id)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT external_key)=count(*)
    AND bool_and(coalesce(valid,false)) AS rows_valid,
  bool_or($6::bigint IS NOT NULL AND ((actor_id=$6) IS DISTINCT FROM (external_key=$7::text))) AS club_conflict,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE actor_id=$6)::int AS club_count,
  sum(row_bytes)::int AS row_bytes,
  sum(row_bytes) FILTER (WHERE actor_id=$6)::int AS club_row_bytes FROM entries GROUP BY snapshot_id
), components AS (
 SELECT s.snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS component_count,bool_and(c.valid) AS components_valid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.actor_id=$6::bigint)::int AS club_component_count
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT c.team_id AS actor_id,c.component_period ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND c.component_period<>'0000' AND coalesce(c.value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.national_association_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_points_with_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_bonus_for_title_held::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_total_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid FROM football.team_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769
) c
WHERE s.subject_kind='team' AND s.complete GROUP BY s.snapshot_id
UNION ALL
SELECT s.snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS component_count,bool_and(c.valid) AS components_valid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.actor_id=$6::bigint)::int AS club_component_count
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT c.association_id AS actor_id,c.component_period ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND c.component_period<>'0000' AND coalesce(c.value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.national_association_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_points_with_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_bonus_for_title_held::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_total_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid FROM football.association_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769
) c
WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete GROUP BY s.snapshot_id
)
SELECT scope.*,f.row_count,f.rows_valid,f.club_conflict,f.club_count,f.row_bytes,f.club_row_bytes,

  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.published_at) THEN
 to_char(s.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS published_at,
  sys.code AS kind,src.code AS source_code,d.id AS document_id,d.source_id,d.content_sha256,
  CASE WHEN octet_length(d.source_url)<=2048 THEN d.source_url END AS source_url,

 JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=s.source_document_id
 JOIN ingest.sources src ON src.id=d.source_id
 JOIN ingest.source_datasets ds ON ds.id=d.dataset_id AND ds.source_id=d.source_id
  AND ds.contract_version='orion-rankings-v1' AND ds.dataset_key='rankings:' || sys.code
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=d.id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
 WHERE s.recorded_from_gen<=$1::bigint
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR sys.code=$3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR s.edition_key=$4)
  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR src.code=$5)
  AND ((sys.code='uefa-associations' AND sys.subject_kind='association')
    OR (sys.code IN ('fifa-men','uefa-clubs') AND sys.subject_kind='team'))
  AND ((src.code='uefa' AND sys.authority='UEFA' AND sys.code<>'fifa-men' AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}[.]uefa$')
    OR (src.code='fifa' AND sys.authority='FIFA' AND sys.code='fifa-men'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]fifa$')
    OR (src.code='sportsapi' AND sys.authority='SportsAPI'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]sportsapi$'))

 SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.team_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 r.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.document_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN s.source_code='uefa' THEN r.external_key ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    ELSE char_length(btrim(r.external_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.external_key !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' END
  AND char_length(btrim(p.display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND p.display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  AND coalesce(char_length(p.country_code_source)<=64 AND p.country_code_source !~ '[[:cntrl:]]',true)

      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.team_source_ids m ON m.team_id=e.team_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records mr ON mr.id=m.source_record_id AND mr.source_id=m.source_id AND mr.external_key=m.external_id
LEFT JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.team_id=e.team_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key

LEFT JOIN football.association_profile_versions p ON p.association_id=e.association_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key

) c

 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769

 to_char(s.source_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS source_updated_at,

 to_char(s.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS published_at,

  s.id AS snapshot_id,s.system_id,s.subject_kind,s.edition_key,s.official_edition,
  CASE WHEN octet_length(s.period_label)<=1024 THEN s.period_label END AS period_label,
  coalesce(octet_length(s.period_label)>1024,false) AS long_period,
  s.recorded_from_gen AS observed_gen,s.revision,s.base_season_year,s.target_season_year,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.effective_on) THEN to_char(s.effective_on,'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS effective_on,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.retrieved_at) THEN
 to_char(s.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS retrieved_at,CASE WHEN isfinite(s.source_updated_at) THEN
 to_char(s.source_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS source_updated_at,
  CASE WHEN isfinite(s.published_at) THEN
 to_char(s.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END AS published_at,
  sys.code AS kind,src.code AS source_code,d.id AS document_id,d.source_id,d.content_sha256,
  CASE WHEN octet_length(d.source_url)<=2048 THEN d.source_url END AS source_url,
  coalesce(s.quality_flags->'ranking_collection_complete'='true'::jsonb,false) AS complete
 FROM football.ranking_snapshots s
 JOIN football.ranking_systems sys ON sys.id=s.system_id AND sys.subject_kind=s.subject_kind
  AND sys.recorded_from_gen<=s.recorded_from_gen AND sys.gender='men'
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots origin ON origin.generation=s.recorded_from_gen AND origin.status='sealed'
 JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=s.source_document_id
 JOIN ingest.sources src ON src.id=d.source_id
 JOIN ingest.source_datasets ds ON ds.id=d.dataset_id AND ds.source_id=d.source_id
  AND ds.contract_version='orion-rankings-v1' AND ds.dataset_key='rankings:' || sys.code
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=d.id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
 WHERE s.recorded_from_gen<=$1::bigint
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR sys.code=$3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR s.edition_key=$4)
  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR src.code=$5)
  AND ((sys.code='uefa-associations' AND sys.subject_kind='association')
    OR (sys.code IN ('fifa-men','uefa-clubs') AND sys.subject_kind='team'))
  AND ((src.code='uefa' AND sys.authority='UEFA' AND sys.code<>'fifa-men' AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}[.]uefa$')
    OR (src.code='fifa' AND sys.authority='FIFA' AND sys.code='fifa-men'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]fifa$')
    OR (src.code='sportsapi' AND sys.authority='SportsAPI'
        AND s.edition_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[.]sportsapi$'))
 ORDER BY s.system_id,s.edition_key,s.revision DESC
), scope AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM latest ORDER BY kind COLLATE "C" DESC,edition_key COLLATE "C" DESC,system_id
 LIMIT 513
), entries AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.team_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 r.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.document_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN s.source_code='uefa' THEN r.external_key ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    ELSE char_length(btrim(r.external_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.external_key !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' END
  AND char_length(btrim(p.display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND p.display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  AND coalesce(char_length(p.country_code_source)<=64 AND p.country_code_source !~ '[[:cntrl:]]',true)
  AND coalesce(e.points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(e.earned_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid,
  512 + 2 * (coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.display_name)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.country_code_source)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT e.* FROM football.team_ranking_entries e WHERE e.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id 
 ORDER BY e.team_id LIMIT 4097
) e
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.team_source_ids m ON m.team_id=e.team_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records mr ON mr.id=m.source_record_id AND mr.source_id=m.source_id AND mr.external_key=m.external_id
LEFT JOIN football.team_profile_versions p ON p.team_id=e.team_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key
 AND p.variant_key='source:exact' AND p.is_canonical AND p.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT p.is_deleted

WHERE s.subject_kind='team' AND s.complete
UNION ALL
SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.association_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 r.id IS NOT NULL AND sd.document_id IS NOT NULL AND mr.id IS NOT NULL AND p.id IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE WHEN s.source_code='uefa' THEN r.external_key ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    ELSE char_length(btrim(r.external_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.external_key !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' END
  AND char_length(btrim(p.display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND p.display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  AND coalesce(char_length(p.country_code_source)<=64 AND p.country_code_source !~ '[[:cntrl:]]',true)
  AND coalesce(e.coefficient::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(e.earned_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid,
  512 + 2 * (coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.display_name)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(p.country_code_source)::text),0)
      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT e.* FROM football.association_ranking_entries e WHERE e.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id 
 ORDER BY e.association_id LIMIT 4097
) e
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.association_source_ids m ON m.association_id=e.association_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records mr ON mr.id=m.source_record_id AND mr.source_id=m.source_id AND mr.external_key=m.external_id
LEFT JOIN football.association_profile_versions p ON p.association_id=e.association_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key
 AND p.variant_key='source:exact' AND p.is_canonical AND p.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT p.is_deleted

WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete
), facts AS (
 SELECT snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS row_count,
  count(DISTINCT actor_id)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT external_key)=count(*)
    AND bool_and(coalesce(valid,false)) AS rows_valid,
  bool_or($6::bigint IS NOT NULL AND ((actor_id=$6) IS DISTINCT FROM (external_key=$7::text))) AS club_conflict,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE actor_id=$6)::int AS club_count,
  sum(row_bytes)::int AS row_bytes,
  sum(row_bytes) FILTER (WHERE actor_id=$6)::int AS club_row_bytes FROM entries GROUP BY snapshot_id
), components AS (
 SELECT s.snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS component_count,bool_and(c.valid) AS components_valid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.actor_id=$6::bigint)::int AS club_component_count
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT c.team_id AS actor_id,c.component_period ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND c.component_period<>'0000' AND coalesce(c.value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.national_association_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_points_with_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_bonus_for_title_held::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_total_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid FROM football.team_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769
) c
WHERE s.subject_kind='team' AND s.complete GROUP BY s.snapshot_id
UNION ALL
SELECT s.snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS component_count,bool_and(c.valid) AS components_valid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.actor_id=$6::bigint)::int AS club_component_count
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT c.association_id AS actor_id,c.component_period ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND c.component_period<>'0000' AND coalesce(c.value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.national_association_points::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_value::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.total_points_with_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_bonus_for_title_held::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AND coalesce(c.factor_total_bonus::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'),true) AS valid FROM football.association_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769
) c
WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete GROUP BY s.snapshot_id
)
SELECT scope.*,f.row_count,f.rows_valid,f.club_conflict,f.club_count,f.row_bytes,f.club_row_bytes,
 c.component_count,c.components_valid,c.club_component_count
FROM scope LEFT JOIN facts f USING(snapshot_id) LEFT JOIN components c USING(snapshot_id)
ORDER BY scope.kind COLLATE "C" DESC,scope.edition_key COLLATE "C" DESC,scope.system_id

 SELECT s.id AS snapshot_id,s.subject_kind,s.recorded_from_gen AS observed_gen,s.edition_key,

 FROM football.ranking_snapshots s

  coalesce(seasonal.parts,'[]'::jsonb) AS parts
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT e.* FROM football.team_ranking_entries e WHERE e.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id AND ($3::bigint IS NULL OR e.team_id=$3)
 ORDER BY e.team_id LIMIT 4097

LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint
LEFT JOIN football.team_source_ids m ON m.team_id=e.team_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id
 AND m.external_id=r.external_key AND m.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<m.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT m.is_deleted

 FROM football.team_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id AND c.team_id=e.team_id

WHERE s.subject_kind='team' AND s.complete
UNION ALL
SELECT s.snapshot_id,e.association_id AS actor_id,e.rank,r.external_key,r.document_id,r.ordinal,
 e.coefficient::text AS points,e.earned_points::text,e.previous_rank,p.display_name,p.country_code_source,

 ORDER BY e.association_id LIMIT 4097
) e
LEFT JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=e.source_record_id AND r.source_id=s.source_id AND r.record_kind='ranking_entry_v1'
LEFT JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.document_id=r.document_id AND sd.snapshot_id=$2::bigint

LEFT JOIN football.association_profile_versions p ON p.association_id=e.association_id AND p.source_id=s.source_id
 AND p.source_record_id=r.id AND p.profile_context='ranking:' || s.kind || ':' || s.edition_key
 AND p.variant_key='source:exact' AND p.is_canonical AND p.recorded_from_gen<=s.observed_gen
 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)
 AND NOT p.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('period',c.component_period,'value',c.value::text,'national_association_points',c.national_association_points::text,'total_value',c.total_value::text,'total_points_with_bonus',c.total_points_with_bonus::text,'factor_bonus_for_title_held',c.factor_bonus_for_title_held::text,'factor_total_bonus',c.factor_total_bonus::text,'component_rank',c.component_rank,'matches_count',c.matches_count,'teams_count',c.teams_count,'teams_still_playing',c.teams_still_playing ) ORDER BY c.component_period COLLATE "C") AS parts
 FROM football.association_ranking_components c
 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id AND c.association_id=e.association_id
) seasonal ON true
WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete
)

FROM analytics.catalog_publication p

WHERE p.singleton AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions pub
 JOIN analytics.aggregation_builds b ON b.id=pub.build_id AND b.status='ready'
  AND b.competition_season_id=pub.competition_season_id AND b.catalog_snapshot_id=pub.catalog_snapshot_id
  AND b.representation_version=pub.representation_version
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
 WHERE pub.catalog_snapshot_id=c.id AND pub.representation_version=p.representation_version
  AND pub.published_to_gen IS NULL
)

      + coalesce(octet_length(to_json(r.external_key)::text),0)) AS row_bytes
FROM scope s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

LEFT JOIN football.association_source_ids m ON m.association_id=e.association_id AND m.source_id=s.source_id

 AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR s.observed_gen<p.recorded_to_gen)

WHERE s.subject_kind='association' AND s.complete
), facts AS (
 SELECT snapshot_id,count(*)::int AS row_count,
  count(DISTINCT actor_id)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT external_key)=count(*)
    AND bool_and(coalesce(valid,false)) AS rows_valid,

) c

 WHERE c.snapshot_id=s.snapshot_id LIMIT 32769
